Performs noninvasive cardiac diagnostic procedures for both inpatient and outpatient populations, including 12‑lead electrocardiograms (ECGs), Holter and event monitoring, ambulatory blood pressure monitoring, exercise treadmill testing (ETT), exercise and pharmacologic stress testing (ESE, DSE, bicycle stress echo), and extended cardiac rhythm monitoring using patch monitors. Ensures accurate acquisition, documentation, and appropriate workflow integration of studies within the electronic medical record system. Demonstrates comprehensive knowledge of cardiac arrhythmias to support ECG interpretation, ambulatory monitoring, and stress testing procedures. Assists with training and competency development of student volunteers and clinical staff. Utilizes clinical information systems effectively and performs basic administrative functions including scheduling, coordination of studies, and communication with patients and care teams. Maintains current knowledge, skills, and compliance with clinical standards to provide high-quality patient care, and performs other duties as assigned. #CA-SB
Establishes and maintains ethical working relationships and good rapport with all patients and staff members.
Technical skills required for performing EKG, Exercise Stress procedures, Ambulatory Monitors as well as hook-up, removal and download of Holter, Event, & Blood Pressure monitor procedures.
Knowledge of basic cardiac rhythm identification.
Ability to operate various clinical equipment (i.e. EKG machine, treadmill, ambulatory monitors, computer systems).
Ability to provide educational training to patients, staff and students.
Ability to read, write, take accurate messages, answer phones and enter data into computer systems.
Skills required performing technically good quality procedures on Infant, children, adolescents, adults and geriatrics.
